declarations.description:
A collapsible, searchable JSON tree. Every line can copy its path or its value.

Hand it any JSON value through `data`, as a property or as a JSON string in the attribute:

```html
<c2-json-viewer data='{"user":{"name":"Ada","roles":["admin"]}}'></c2-json-viewer>
```

The top-level entries of an object or array are the first lines; a branch shows its size while collapsed.
`expand-depth` decides how many levels start open, and `expandAll()` / `collapseAll()` reset every branch.
A branch with more than `page-size` children shows that many and a "show more" line for the rest.

`search` highlights every key and value containing the text (case-insensitive) and opens the branches on the
way to each match; `filter` also hides the lines that lead to no match. The viewer has no search box of its
own, so pair it with `c2-search-field`. `searchMatches` lists the paths that matched.

Only the lines in view are rendered, so a document with hundreds of thousands of visible lines scrolls like a short
one; each line is one row high and a long value is cut off with an ellipsis (its full text is in the tooltip and in
"copy value"). Treat `data` as immutable: assign a new value rather than mutating the current one, since the viewer
caches each object's keys.

Paths are written as JSONPath (`$.user.roles[0]`) or, with `path-format="pointer"`, as JSON Pointer
(`/user/roles/0`). A circular reference shows as `[Circular]` rather than recursing.

### Keyboard

Arrow Up and Down walk the lines. Arrow Right opens a branch, then moves to its first child; Arrow Left closes
it, then moves to its parent. Page Up and Page Down move a screen at a time, Home and End jump to the ends, Enter and Space toggle a branch (or reveal the
rest of a long one), `*` opens every sibling. `C` (or Ctrl/Cmd + C) copies the focused line's value, `P` its path.
declarations.name: JsonViewer

cssProperties.description: Text colour, and the colour of punctuation.
cssProperties.name: --c2-json-viewer--color

cssProperties.description: Height at which the viewer starts scrolling.
cssProperties.name: --c2-json-viewer--max-height

cssProperties.description: Height of every line. Lines never wrap, which is what lets the viewer render only the ones in view.
cssProperties.name: --c2-json-viewer__row--height

cssProperties.description: Corner radius of a hovered or focused line.
cssProperties.name: --c2-json-viewer__row--border-radius

cssProperties.description: Colour of a branch's size summary.
cssProperties.name: --c2-json-viewer__summary--color

cssProperties.description: Text colour of search matches. Defaults to the token colour.
cssProperties.name: --c2-json-viewer__match--color

cssProperties.description: Background of a hovered copy button.
cssProperties.name: --c2-json-viewer__action__hover--background-color

cssProperties.description: Colour of a copy button after a successful copy.
cssProperties.name: --c2-json-viewer__action__copied--color

cssParts.description: The scrolling container holding the lines.
cssParts.name: tree

cssParts.description: The value of a leaf, or the size summary of a branch.
cssParts.name: value
match
cssParts.description: Shadow DOM styling hook for the match element.

slots.description: Shown instead of the tree while `data` is undefined.
slots.name: empty

members.name: data
members.description: The JSON value to show. As an attribute it is parsed as JSON.

members.name: expandDepth
members.description: How many levels start open: 1 shows the top-level entries closed, 2 also opens them. Applied when `data` changes.

members.name: search
members.description: Highlights the keys and values containing this text and opens the branches leading to them.

members.name: filter
members.description: With `search`, hides every line that leads to no match.

members.name: sortKeys
members.description: Shows object keys in alphabetical order rather than insertion order.

members.name: pathFormat
members.description: How copied and reported paths are written: `jsonpath` (`$.a[0]`) or `pointer` (`/a/0`).

members.name: pageSize
members.description: How many children of a branch are shown before a "show more" line.

members.name: overrides
members.description: Branches opened or closed by the user, overriding the depth rule.

members.name: searchOverrides
members.description: Branches toggled while a search is active; dropped with the search so the earlier expansion comes back.

members.name: openDepth
members.description: Branches below this level start closed. Reset from `expandDepth` with the data.

members.name: rowHeight
members.description: Measured from a rendered line, so a themed `--c2-json-viewer__row--height` or font size is honoured.

members.name: focusedIndex
members.description: Index of the focused line in `rows`, kept with `focusedId`.

members.name: searchMatches
members.description: Paths of the nodes matching `search`, in document order, written in `path-format`.

members.name: collapseAll
members.description: Closes every branch, leaving the top-level entries.

members.name: updateWindow
members.description: Works out which lines intersect both the viewport and the host's own scroll box.

members.name: highlight
members.description: Wraps each case-insensitive occurrence of the search text in a `<mark>`.

events.name: expansion-change
events.description: Fired after the user opens or closes a branch. Does not bubble.

events.name: copy-error
events.description: Fired when the clipboard write failed.

events.name: copied
events.description: Fired after a path or value reached the clipboard.
